title: engineAssets never reach the Pod's fast disk - extend hot-store staging past the model-keyed paths
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-512 - Remote install and Pod disk (consolidation sweep 2026-08-10). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-512/plan.md.

Found live 2026-07-30 on the MPI-385 Pod session. sam3-multiplex (1.75GB) loads off the ~750MB/s network volume on every cold ComfyUI load (~8.5s first Detect), because BOTH stage-to-disk paths are model-keyed: _ensureRemoteHotStore(modelId,...) resolves deps per model (commandExecutor.js:534) and prefetchInstalledModels iterates s_installedModelIds - an engineAsset belongs to NO model, so it is invisible to both. runAutoMask does not call the hot-store preflight at all. The user floated baking it into the image; MPI-380 already rejected bake deliberately (+1.75GB on every image pull forever, dev+stable rebuilds, repeats per engineAsset - see tasks/MPI-380/validation.md FIX SHIPPED section). CHEAPER FIX, same speed, no rebuild: POST /remote/hot-store/ensure accepts arbitrary {type, filename, size_bytes, sha256} - it does not care about model ownership. Stage the non-baked engineAsset set (>=100MB, VRAM-capped, same filters as _ensureRemoteHotStore) on the remote connect edge right after _installRemoteEngineAssets - one ~2.5s volume-to-disk copy per Pod, idempotent/sticky on the wrapper side, then SAM3 loads at NVMe speed. NOTE the split with MPI-402: this fixes COLD Detect (weight load); the 2-3s chip toggling is the round trip, not the load (model stays RAM-resident between Detects) - that is MPI-402's client-side mask cache.
acceptance: Non-baked engineAssets >=100MB are staged to the Pod's fast disk on the connect edge, after _installRemoteEngineAssets, same size/VRAM filters as _ensureRemoteHotStore
Idempotent: a warm Pod's connect stages nothing and shows no toast
Cold SAM3 Detect load time drops measurably (volume ~750MB/s to local NVMe)
bakedOnPod assets are never staged (already image-resident)
Best-effort: hot-store failure never blocks the connect or the Detect
